title: The venture-bound team
subtitle: A Delaware request driven by an investor conversation
prompt: We're two founders based in India building a SaaS product. A US investor asked for a Delaware C-corp before discussing a seed round. Our Indian company already owns the code and pays the developers. Can we just put the US company on top and move the IP?
provided: An Indian company owns the code and employs developers
A prospective investor requests a Delaware C corporation
Proposed US holding structure and IP transfer
missing: Full ownership and tax residency of each founder
Current cap table and outstanding rights
IP assignments, valuation, and existing obligations
Indian legal, tax, and foreign-exchange constraints

questions.question: Who owns each existing entity and what options, convertible instruments, or consent rights exist?
questions.why: The reorganization must account for existing ownership and contracts.

questions.question: What structure has the investor actually requested, and is there a term sheet?
questions.why: Distinguish a confirmed transaction requirement from an informal preference.

questions.question: Who created and legally owns the code, and which assignments or licenses are already signed?
questions.why: Establish the rights available for transfer or licensing before proposing a structure.

questions.question: Which entity will sell, employ staff, fund development, and bear commercial risk?
questions.why: Map future related-party services and IP transactions for pricing analysis.

questions.question: Which Indian advisers can review the restructuring, valuation, and cross-border investment rules?
questions.why: Local legal and tax treatment is outside this US-focused source pack.

concerns.title: An IP transfer is a separate transaction
concerns.detail: Related-party IP and development arrangements require pricing and documentation review; formation does not settle them.

concerns.title: Foreign ownership reporting
concerns.detail: A qualifying foreign-owned US corporation with reportable related-party transactions may have Form 5472 obligations.

concerns.title: Budget for ongoing corporate obligations
concerns.detail: Delaware franchise tax calculations require corporate inputs and are distinct from federal taxes.

specialists.decision: Design the cap table, financing structure, IP chain of title, and transaction documents.
specialists.needs: Term sheet, cap tables, existing agreements and IP assignments

specialists.decision: Compare restructuring routes, valuation, transfer pricing, and local approvals. No tax-neutral flip is assumed.
specialists.needs: Entity financials, IP valuation, cash-flow plan and local-law sources

takeaway: The incorporation is one step inside a cross-border restructuring.
